Tom S. (Sales): Hey team — CorpEcom just asked for a Dedicated plan for their search + chat features. They expect big spikes on Black Friday. Quick summary: steady traffic ~150 qps embeddings (batch 64), chat avg concurrent 600 users, avg output 220 tokens, peak burst need up to ~14 GPUs for a few hours. They want 99.9% availability, p95 chat latency <350ms. Can you advise sizing + burst/autoscale options? :eyes:

Olivia (PM): thanks Tom. Do we know model family (Llama2-like, mix/embeddings model), quantization tolerance, and whether they accept fallback to a smaller variant? Also timeline for contract?

Tom S. (Sales): Contract timeline is end of month. They prefer open models (60% llama2-variant for chat, embeddings on a smaller dimension model). Willing to accept int8 quantized variants if we validate quality.

Reza (Eng): initial thoughts: embeddings are batching-friendly — 150 qps with batch=64 maps to ~2-3 concurrent GPUs depending on throughput. Chat with 600 concurrent and 220-token outputs depends heavily on context length and decode speed. Important: KV cache warmup for chat on cold nodes will spike latency if we don't pre-warm cache or use warm pools.

Reza (Eng): rough approach: reserve a baseline pool for steady-state (handles embeddings + chat baseline), then scheduled burst capacity for Black Friday windows. Autoscaling should have a fast scale-up (minutes) and conservative scale-down to avoid oscillation.

Nina K. (Infra): +1 on warm pools. We can create a warm standby fleet with preloaded models/kv caches. Suggested autoscale policy (draft):

```
# autoscale policy (pseudo)
min_capacity: 3  # baseline GPUs
scale_up: if queue_len > 50 or p95_latency > 300ms -> add +2 GPUs (cooldown 90s)
scheduled_windows:
  - start: 2024-11-29T00:00:00Z
    end: 2024-11-29T06:00:00Z
    target_capacity: 14
scale_down: if cpu_util < 30% and queue_len < 10 -> remove -1 (cooldown 600s)
burst_pool: allow borrow up to 6 GPUs from shared pool
```

Nina K. (Infra): we should also set a hard quota so customer burst can't starve other tenants.

Kevin L. (Solutions): For pricing/contract options to present:
- Option A (Commit-light): commit 4 GPUs baseline + burst credits (pay-per-burst) with scheduled assured burst windows. Lower upfront, higher burst unit rate.
- Option B (Commit-heavy): commit 8 GPUs reserve, cheaper per-GPU rate, smaller burst cushion.

Kevin L. (Solutions): For launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- perf bench for their combos (embedding batch sizes, chat seq length)
- canary ramp (5% -> 20% -> 100%) with automatic fallback to quantized variant on perf regressions
- observability: per-route token/latency cost breakdown, KV cache hit rates, OOM/retry alerts
- SLO runbook and rollback triggers

Olivia (PM): Perfect — can we attach a short risk matrix? High risks: insufficient warm capacity causing p95 spikes, model quality regression when switching to int8, billing surprises on burst. Mitigations: warm pools, eval prompt-suites for int8, burst budget caps.

Reza (Eng): Also note: sequence-length distribution matters a lot. If 20% of chat requests include long context (+2k tokens), we need more memory per request and that changes GPU counts. Ask customer for a histogram of context lengths.

Tom S. (Sales): I'll request the context-length histogram and confirm whether they can accept a 5% quality delta for int8. Also need a pricing anchor today to share with procurement.

Kevin L. (Solutions): I'll draft two price anchors (A and B) and an ops playbook. Will include expected token/unit economics for baseline vs burst.

Olivia (PM): Reza/Nina — can you produce a quick sizing note with assumptions (model choices, batch sizes, seq dist) and a recommended autoscale snippet by EOD tomorrow? I want that in the sales packet.

Reza (Eng): Can do. Will include a test plan and estimated perf numbers (p95 token latency, tokens/sec) under our infra assumptions.

Nina K. (Infra): I'll add the warm-pool config and recommended hard quota policy. Also will note expected cold-start times and strategies (preload hooks).

deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-1984: "CorpEcom dedicated sizing + burst plan" assigned to Olivia, Reza, Nina, Kevin.

Olivia (PM): thanks all — once we have the sizing note + price anchors I'll sync with Tom to finalize the offer. :rocket:
